```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Observations"
#| icon: calendar3
#| color: primary
import pandas as pd

# Data lives in its own data/ subfolder, separate from code -- a habit
# worth keeping as this repo grows. Use forward slashes in the path,
# even on Windows: Python/pandas accept them on every OS, so the same
# code runs unchanged whether you're on Windows, Mac, or Linux. A
# single backslash (data\file.csv) is NOT safe here -- Python reads
# backslashes as escape characters inside a string, which can silently
# produce the wrong path.
df = pd.read_csv("data/macro_var_synthetic.csv", parse_dates=["date"])
dict(value=len(df))
```

## Row {height=55%}

```{python}
#| title: "Output Gap, Inflation, and Policy Rate"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

plt.rcParams['figure.figsize'] = (11, 4)

tab10 = plt.get_cmap("tab10")
colors = {"output_gap": tab10(0), "inflation": tab10(1), "policy_rate": tab10(2)}

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
for var in variables:
    ax.plot(df["date"], df[var], label=var, color=colors[var], linewidth=1.2)
ax.legend(loc="upper left", frameon=False)
ax.set_xlim(df["date"].min(), df["date"].max())
plt.show()
```

## Row {height=30%}

### Column {width=60%}

```{python}
#| title: "Stationarity (ADF Test)"
from statsmodels.tsa.stattools import adfuller
from tabulate import tabulate
from IPython.display import Markdown

rows = []
for var in variables:
    result = adfuller(df[var], autolag="AIC")
    verdict = "Stationary" if result[1] < 0.05 else "Unit root"
    rows.append([var, f"{result[0]:.3f}", f"{result[1]:.4f}", verdict])

adf_table = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["Variable", "ADF Stat", "p-value", "Result"])
Markdown(tabulate(adf_table, showindex=False, headers=adf_table.columns))
```

# Model Results

## Row {.tabset height=100%}

### Granger Causality

```{python}
from statsmodels.tsa.api import VAR
from statsmodels.stats.diagnostic import acorr_ljungbox

model = VAR(df.set_index("date")[variables])
fit = model.fit(2)

rows = []
for cause in variables:
    for effect in variables:
        if cause == effect:
            continue
        test = fit.test_causality(effect, [cause], kind="f")
        verdict = "Causes" if test.pvalue < 0.05 else "No evidence"
        rows.append([cause, effect, f"{test.test_statistic:.2f}", f"{test.pvalue:.4f}", verdict])

granger_table = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["Cause", "Effect", "F-stat", "p-value", "Result"])
Markdown(tabulate(granger_table, showindex=False, headers=granger_table.columns))
```
